name: issue-detail-01
title: Issue Detail 01
description: An issue page (Linear style) — status circle and a large title that edits in place, a Notion-style description, a separator, then comments; a Properties rail with a Details sheet on small screens.

meta.whenToUse: A task or issue page — title, description, comments and a properties rail; compose the same components in your app.
meta.whenNotToUse: A meeting or media record with tabs — use RecordLayout with Tabs.
